item.title: azure: [In preview] Public Preview: ECMP Nexthop
item.description:
Azure Virtual Network now supports ECMP routing in public preview. It lets customers use a single user-defined route to distribute traffic across 2 to 16 next hops.

  • Source: Azure Updates
